name: Forces of Jaedenar
summary: Greta Mosshoof asks you to enter Jaedenar and face its forces. She awaits your return in Felwood.

sections.title: Felwood's Charge
sections.body: Greta Mosshoof waits in Felwood for your return. In Jaedenar, you face Hounds, Guardsmen, Adepts, and Cultists; Greta asks you to slay them before coming back.

faq.q: Who asks me to go to Jaedenar?
faq.answer: Greta Mosshoof asks you to enter Jaedenar and slay its Hounds, Guardsmen, Adepts, and Cultists.
Greta Mosshoof directs you to Jaedenar, then asks you to return to her in Felwood.
Greta names Jaedenar Hounds, Jaedenar Guardsmen, Jaedenar Adepts, and Jaedenar Cultists.

faq.q: How many of each does Greta ask me to slay?
faq.answer: Greta asks you to slay four Hounds, four Guardsmen, six Adepts, and six Cultists.

attribution: In-game quest text: Forces of Jaedenar
